analysis.one_line_summary: A Black Friday promotional graphic designed like a store receipt offering 27% off the Wavytalk Steambrush Pro 2.0 at $79.20.
analysis.full_description: A square static promotional ad formatted as a crumpled paper store receipt against a dark textured purple background. At the top of the receipt is the Wavytalk brand logo, 'Black Friday', and the highlighted pricing '$79.20 | 27% OFF'. The receipt body lists the line item 'STEAMBRUSH PRO 2.0 Steam Straightener Brush' with a quantity of 1, accompanied by a product image of the pale pink steam hairbrush emitting steam. A round plum badge to the right reads 'TODAY ONLY'.
